name: Worktree Collection
description: Shows a conversation's worktree collection: its repositories with pending changes, pull requests with CI, and running services, in a panel and a card above the message box.

teamTailnet.description: The gateway's tailnet is the team's, not a person's: offer Tailscale tunnels to services, which everyone on it can reach.

harnesses.description: Harness repositories this gateway's collections work in. A collection uses one: its first wtc add-repo adds a worktree of the harness, and repository names resolve through the harness's .harness-repos.yml. None configured: every collection is ad hoc.

name.description: Short name, as wtc add-repo --harness takes it.

remote.description: The harness repository on GitHub or Bitbucket, as an HTTPS or git@ URL. The gateway must have it as a project.

ref.description: Branch new worktrees of the harness start from.

pullRequestEvents.description: How a collection's conversation hears that a pull request of it was opened, merged or closed, became ready, failed or passed its checks, was approved, got a request for changes or conflicts with its base: wake gives it a turn now, queue tells it on its next turn, off says nothing.

pullRequestPollMinutes.description: How often collections with an open pull request are looked at while nobody has their card open. 0 looks only when a card does.

defaultHarness.description: Chooses between harnesses whose registries list the repositories a new collection adds, and stands in when none lists them (as the only configured harness does). A harness that lists them beats it; a repository the chosen harness does not list is asked about.
